wiki.summary: "Sleepyhead" is the debut single from American electronic band Passion Pit, featured on their first EP, Chunk of Change, and later on their debut album Manners. The song contains samples of Óró Mo Bháidín by Mary O'Hara and San Francisco Scene (The Beat Generation) by Jack Kerouac ("and everything is going to the beat"). It was featured on the Palm Pixi commercial, Current TV's Ads for "Max and Jason: Still Up" and multiple LittleBigPlanet 2 trailers. Read more on Last.fm.
